messages:
Ivy Chen: Quick kickoff for SapphireNode preview (SN-1). NDA is in place. Need bench matrix, telemetry sampling, and marketplace preview copy by end of week.
Marco Ruiz: Partner can ship images Tue AM. I'd like to run compatibility + kv-cache tests against `rc/sapphire-sn1`.
Anya Petrov: Proposed minimal bench: correctness, warm throughput sweep, 30m sustained soak, cold-start capture. Perf gates (preview): rwd-13b p50<70ms p95<240ms @8k.
Legal Bot: NDA: signed. Partner requested a 7-day mutual embargo after internal signoff. Also trademark for logo must be cleared before publish.
Ivy Chen: Marketplace Team — can you draft a preview listing that uses "preview access" language and partner badge placeholder? No GA claims.
Marketplace Team: Yep. Will avoid pricing and GA. Need a sanitized console screenshot or we will mock one.
Marco Ruiz: Infra note: add runtime fallback to `sapphire-sn1-quant` for OOMs and thermal backoff policy. infra-bot: fallback flag added to `feat/sapphire-eap` branch.
Bench Ops: Slot reserved Thu 22:00-02:00 UTC. Please upload bench configs to https://drive.redwood/apps/sapphire/eap-configs. Job queued: SN-EAP-1210, logs at /runs/SN-EAP-1210.
Anya Petrov: Command (dev): `./bench --target sapphire-sn1 --model rwd-13b --ctx 8192 --mode fp16 --warmup 600 --samples 150 --cold-start`
Ivy Chen: Telemetry plan: 0.5% token sampling, prefix cache hit/miss, anonymize prompts. Legal Bot confirmed telemetry okay without prompt text.
Marketplace Team: Uploading draft listing to drive. Will include partner badge once trademark OK.
Marco Ruiz: Action items: Anya run bench + upload artifacts (Due: Thu EOD), Ivy coordinate trademark + embargo (Due: Fri), Marketplace finalize listing (Due: Fri).
Ivy Chen: Quick sync Fri 08:00 PT to confirm artifacts. If images delayed, ping partner EM. :rocket:
